title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear 1982 soundboard captures a high‑energy set with Jerry’s soaring licks, a monster Terrapin jam and a 12‑minute Scarlet > Fire sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its pristine, clean soundboard quality, though a slight speed/balance quirk is noted. Musically the show shines – Jerry delivers tremendous leads, Brent’s keys lock in perfectly, and the extended Scarlet > Fire transition (along with a jam‑heavy Terrapin Station) is highlighted as a standout moment.

ai_rating.rationale: Three detailed reviews are largely positive about both performance and sound quality; minor critiques on speed/balance lower the rating slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clean, crisp sound with excellent clarity; a slight half‑step fast tempo causes some balance issues but overall the mix is solid.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, jam‑heavy flow with an especially impressive 12‑minute Scarlet > Fire transition; overall a classic '82 performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Tremendous licks and high energy throughout; he ‘digs’ the extended jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Relegated to a background role, less prominent in the mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboard work is perfectly matched to the band’s dynamics.
band_member_comments.Drums: Subtle, deliberate drumming noted during transitions.
